phases.reason: strict precommit transcript byte equality was falsified because membership-equivalent worlds with different unrelated chain volume produced different aggregate progress telemetry
claim uniqueness was object-scoped rather than persistent window-scoped; lineage ledger was mutable and omission/truncation could not be detected
phases.disposition: the weak claim/ledger implementation is not reused

established_in_bounded_offline_model: WINDOW_CLAIM_KEY independent of episode_id and contract revision
changed contract cannot reuse consumed window
successor uses a new non-overlapping window
deterministic sample is invariant to outcome material

non_scored_dependencies.D1: production witness must be instantiated as an actually separate process/service and trust domain, not merely same-process API discipline; V5 resolves this in the external witness trust boundary section
non_scored_dependencies.D2: fencing-authority-transfer policy was not designed; V5 resolves this by eliminating writer handoff

feasibility_evidence_status.prohibition: scratch conclusions are not copied into canonical Git and declared validated by that act alone; V5 independently freezes its own design and must pass its own review

single_shot_episode.window_binding: EXACT_FROZEN_LITERAL; this preregistration is the sole source of the window values; no selection or computation is permitted
single_shot_episode.claim_anchor_deadline_rule: the claim must be authoritatively anchored strictly before CLAIM_ANCHOR_DEADLINE; equality fails

deadline_miss_consequence.terminal: missing the deadline terminally blocks this V5 live episode

single_shot_episode.successor_rule: V5 is a fresh preregistration successor. It does not reopen, patch, resume, or reuse V4 execution authorization; it uses only the exact fixed V5 window and must preserve complete permanent-namespace lineage semantics.

window_claim_identity.timestamp_representation: exact ASCII/RFC3339 UTC string, format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ only; no fractional seconds, no timezone offsets, no alternate equivalent encoding
window_claim_identity.exact_window_object_contract: no missing, null, or extra members
window_claim_identity.formula_is_authoritative: this exact formula is authoritative; no 'equivalently exact byte contract' language applies
window_claim_identity.consumption_is_permanent: a consumed WINDOW_CLAIM_KEY can never become unconsumed
window_claim_identity.overlap_rejection: The witness must reject an exact duplicate key and every second qualification claim whose half-open observation interval overlaps any previously consumed interval in the permanent PR01 window namespace. The blocked V4 authorization attempt produced no CLAIM and consumed no interval; V5 nevertheless has no fallback, dynamic selection, or reuse path.

claim_once_request.binding_member_rule: The request member TERMINAL_CONTRACT_BINDING must be the complete seven-member object defined by the top-level TERMINAL_CONTRACT_BINDING schema; V5 preregistration itself contains only the frozen schema and fixed contract/state values, never the later runtime commit/digest values.

claim_order.boundary_equality_rule: CLAIM_ANCHORED_AT >= CLAIM_ANCHOR_DEADLINE is INVALID; CLAIM_ANCHORED_AT must be strictly less than CLAIM_ANCHOR_DEADLINE
claim_order.crash_before_local_persistence: if CLAIM_ONCE succeeds but the client crashes before the local mirror, WINDOW_CONSUMED=YES; a later process queries the witness and sees the existing claim and must not create another claim
claim_order.ambiguous_submission_result: query the witness by WINDOW_CLAIM_KEY; if an existing claim exists, the window is consumed and no new claim may be created; if absence cannot be established because the witness is unavailable, FAIL CLOSED and no data starts; only if the authoritative witness proves no claim exists may the same pre-data submission attempt be retried
claim_order.no_outcome_data_at_this_stage: no outcome data exists or has been fetched at any point in this sequence

local_claim_mirror.local_role: mirror/cache only; never the claim authority
local_claim_mirror.witness_success_local_failure: WINDOW_CONSUMED=YES; the external CLAIM remains authoritative and discoverable
local_claim_mirror.fresh_machine_recovery: query the witness and recover the existing claim; do not create another claim

witness_claim_once.resolves: interval-aware global claim authority and witness-first ordering
witness_claim_once.rule: the external witness must provide an atomic CLAIM_ONCE operation carrying the exact interval object and its supplied window_claim_key; the witness itself is the cross-machine uniqueness authority
server_recomputation: validate namespace and exact UTC timestamp strings
reconstruct exact_window_object with no missing, null, or extra members
compute lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 as computed_window_claim_key

overlap_rule.scope: every previously consumed interval in the permanent PR01 window namespace

atomicity.operation: overlap check and successful CLAIM append/interval consumption
invariants: the witness never acknowledges CLAIM without a consumed interval registry entry
the witness never consumes an interval without a discoverable CLAIM record

external_witness_trust_boundary.rule: future live execution must not use an in-process-only witness; same-process SQLite is not a production-independent witness
minimum_requirements: an atomic CLAIM_ONCE operation as the cross-machine uniqueness authority
runtime qualification credentials have APPEND/READ/VERIFY only
runtime credentials have NO delete/rewrite/truncate operation
service returns a durable receipt/inclusion identifier
initial_claim_digest is bound in the witnessed record
witness receipt can later be independently verified
local database rollback/truncation is detectable by comparison with witness
successful final evidence cannot omit witnessed prior episodes

production_provider_binding.gate_required_before_measurement: tests of the actual configured witness must PASS before MEASUREMENT_AUTHORIZED = YES

witness_included_at.generated_by: external witness, server-side, at durable CLAIM_ONCE inclusion
witness_included_at.must_be_receipt_bound: cryptographically/receipt-bound to the witnessed claim and part of the independently verifiable receipt

host_receipt_at.captured: immediately after successful receipt verification, using the frozen V1 absolute-UTC-valid host clock contract (receipt_clock.absolute_utc_preflight)
host_receipt_at.requires: the host clock has passed the carried-forward absolute UTC preflight

claim_anchored_at_contract.client_override_forbidden: the client may not supply or override WITNESS_INCLUDED_AT
claim_anchored_at_contract.execution_ineligibility: an actual witness implementation is execution-ineligible unless its receipt semantics prove the timestamp is server-assigned at durable inclusion

writer_handoff_and_fencing.rule: one episode has one writer authority, mechanically enforced by writer_identity_mechanism below, not merely by policy wording

test.scenario: writer A starts; writer A fails; writer B attempts continuation with a new key

writer_identity_mechanism.generation: one ephemeral signing keypair generated at execution start, process-local
rules: public key is bound into CLAIM_ONCE
every subsequent witness event for that episode must carry the same writer_public_key
every subsequent event must contain a valid signature made by the corresponding private key
private key is process-ephemeral and MUST NOT be persisted to disk, database, evidence package, environment variable, secret store, or witness
writer_identity_mechanism.writer_death_consequence: if the writer process dies and loses its private key, the same episode cannot produce further valid events; a new writer cannot substitute another key; the window is already consumed by CLAIM_ONCE
writer_identity_mechanism.future_implementation_test_requirement: future implementation tests must prove no supported restart/resume path can append a valid event using a different writer key
writer_identity_mechanism.fencing_token_note: if a fencing value remains, it is not an authority-transfer mechanism; fencing-authority-transfer policy (lease timing / quorum) remains explicitly undesigned and out of scope

abort_semantics.new_window_requires: a NEW preregistration lineage/version, which must preserve V5 failure evidence and use a new non-overlapping window only
abort_semantics.successor_namespace_requirement: any future PR01 qualification claim MUST use the same permanent PR01_WINDOW_NAMESPACE and PR01_LINEAGE_NAMESPACE; the final verifier must enumerate prior witnessed attempts so a future success cannot masquerade as the first attempt; the permanent namespaces are cross-version protocol constants

namespace_genesis.existing_root_rule: if the namespace already exists, return the same permanent existing root
namespace_genesis.cross_version_rule: never create another root for a later PR01 version

required_semantics: first returned namespace record is the authenticated namespace genesis/root
witness_sequence values are contiguous under the namespace ordering contract
no unexplained sequence or event gap
inclusion verification for every returned event
consistency proof that current checkpoint extends the pinned genesis checkpoint
runtime qualification credentials cannot delete/rewrite/truncate history

final_verification_algorithm: enumerate every PR01_LINEAGE_NAMESPACE event using LIST_NAMESPACE_FROM_GENESIS(PR01_LINEAGE_NAMESPACE, NAMESPACE_GENESIS_ID)
require the first returned namespace record to be the authenticated pinned genesis/root
require contiguous witness_sequence values with no unexplained sequence or event gap
verify current checkpoint consistency against the pinned genesis checkpoint
reject any supplied older or later checkpoint that attempts to replace the pinned genesis
reject if any external event/window is absent locally
reject history that begins after the pinned genesis
reject a local history that omits any externally witnessed event
reject dangling CLAIM or DATA_STARTED unless represented by a terminally invalid/unfinished lineage state
require current V5 event chain to be complete
final_verification_fail_conditions: local history omits any externally witnessed event
lineage.verification_note: verification of one supplied receipt does not establish lineage completeness; the final qualification verifier must independently query the witness namespace and must not merely verify receipts supplied by the local process

episode_binding.claim_event_rule: the CLAIM event establishes the EPISODE_BINDING tuple
episode_binding.later_event_rule: every later event for that episode must contain exactly the same namespace_genesis_id, namespace_genesis_digest, episode_id, window_claim_key, initial_claim_digest, and writer_public_key
episode_binding.final_verifier_rule: independently assert exact EPISODE_BINDING equality over the complete episode

witness_state_machine.terminal_rule: once TERMINAL_* occurs, no later event is valid; no second DATA_STARTED; no second SAMPLE_COMMITTED; no transition backward; no episode resurrection
witness_state_machine.enforcement: the witness service must reject illegal transitions, not merely record them
witness_state_machine.namespace_genesis_enforcement: every event must bind exactly the authenticated NAMESPACE_GENESIS_ID and NAMESPACE_GENESIS_DIGEST returned for PR01_LINEAGE_NAMESPACE
witness_state_machine.episode_binding_enforcement: every event after CLAIM must bind exactly the immutable EPISODE_BINDING tuple established by CLAIM_ONCE; any mismatch is rejected
witness_state_machine.data_started_ordering: DATA_STARTED must be externally appended successfully before the first provider connection/census request/data operation
witness_state_machine.sample_committed_ordering: SAMPLE_COMMITTED must be externally appended and verified before AUDIT_SAMPLE_COMMIT_BARRIER=PASS

partial_failure_semantics.A_claim_once_rejected_before_durable_app: no window consumed; no data allowed; retry of the same pre-data submission is permitted only after authoritative witness query proves absence
partial_failure_semantics.B_claim_once_appended_no_response: window consumed; query/recovery may retrieve existing receipt; no new claim

distinct sorted mint pair has exactly one fixed-set quote mint and one non-quote mint

complete_chain_census.finalized_evidence_mapping: resolve every required signature and verify its containing block and transaction index; retain response hashes
complete_chain_census.prior_history_check: group all decoded qualifying events by canonical mint and retain only earliest-in-window mints
complete_chain_census.completeness_accounting: retain pages, cursors, signatures, slots, resolutions, candidate/exclusion/unavailable counts, gaps, retries, bytes, credits, and cost
complete_chain_census.fail_closed: archive/pruning, null required primitive, provider gap, rate limit, timeout, malformed response, or unresolved account evidence makes CENSUS_COMPLETE=NO; it never shrinks the denominator
complete_chain_census.resource_ceiling: a ceiling before termination proof yields PACKET_VALID=NO and SOURCE_STACK_QUALIFIED=NO

receipt_clock.start_binding: at qualification process start capture wall_start_utc and mono_start_ns in one synchronous section, with no await or blocking work between the two reads
receipt_clock.observation_binding: for each LIVE_FIRST_OBSERVATION at callback entry capture wall_received_utc and mono_received_ns synchronously, without await; retain the raw pair and sampled offset

clock_skew_tolerance.justification: 250 ms is below 0.21% of the 120-second latency gate and bounds receipt-clock error at a sub-second scale relevant to provider freshness

absolute_utc_preflight.utc_sync_measurement_method: Before qualification and at the frozen health-check cadence, read the active chrony tracking state and validated synchronized-source state. Record the signed local-wall-minus-trusted-UTC offset estimate and a conservative upper error bound that includes the synchronization service uncertainty, root dispersion, and half root delay; a normal/leap-valid synchronized state is required. This is a semantic contract, not a time request performed during preregistration.
absolute_utc_preflight.absolute_utc_offset_estimate: signed seconds: local host wall UTC estimate minus trusted UTC estimate at UTC_SYNC_OBSERVED_AT
absolute_utc_preflight.absolute_utc_error_bound: non-negative seconds: conservative upper bound on the absolute UTC error of the local wall clock at UTC_SYNC_OBSERVED_AT, including measurement uncertainty and synchronization dispersion/delay
absolute_utc_preflight.utc_sync_observed_at: host wall UTC timestamp captured with the synchronization measurement and paired with a monotonic sample

utc_sync_max_age.rule: no receipt observation or checkpoint is valid unless the latest PASS measurement is at most 60 seconds old by monotonic time; a missed or stale health check fails closed

max_absolute_utc_error.rule: at qualification start and every health check, abs(absolute_utc_offset_estimate) + absolute_utc_error_bound <= 0.25 seconds

absolute_utc_preflight.start_and_continuation: CLOCK_PREFLIGHT is PASS only when the start measurement passes and every 60-second maximum-age health check through finalization passes; no local wall-clock fallback is permitted
absolute_utc_preflight.failure_behavior: if trusted UTC state cannot be established, CLOCK_PREFLIGHT=FAIL, LATENCY_PACKET_VALID=NO, DISCOVERY_LATENCY_GATE=NOT_REPORTABLE_INVALID_CLOCK, and SOURCE_STACK_QUALIFIED=NO

validity_rules: source_event_at is non-null and discovery_latency_seconds = wall_received_utc - source_event_at is finite and >= 0
negative latency is INVALID_CLOCK and is never clamped or counted
a wall/monotonic offset discontinuity above 0.25 seconds makes the sequence-defined affected interval INVALID_CLOCK
a receipt observation is eligible for FINITE latency only when CLOCK_PREFLIGHT=PASS, its local wall/monotonic checks pass, and its sequence is not in any invalid checkpoint interval

required_pairs: before each receipt batch when batching exists
after each receipt batch when batching exists
checkpoints.sample_identity: every checkpoint and receipt sample has monotonic_ns and a process-local clock_sample_sequence; sequence starts at 1 and increments exactly once in the synchronous capture section, with no equal sequence values
checkpoints.capture_order: the start checkpoint is sequence 1; each checkpoint or receipt sample obtains its sequence at capture before any later sample; receipt callback capture occurs before callback parsing or await; optional batch-boundary checkpoints are captured in the stated before/after order
checkpoints.first_checkpoint: the first checkpoint has no predecessor and therefore creates no invalid interval; it establishes the initial offset
checkpoints.interval_rule: for consecutive checkpoints C[i-1] and C[i], if abs(offset(C[i]) - offset(C[i-1])) > 0.25 seconds, mark exactly the sequence interval C[i-1].clock_sample_sequence < R.clock_sample_sequence <= C[i].clock_sample_sequence as INVALID_CLOCK for receipt observations R
checkpoints.equality_behavior: the 0.25-second discontinuity comparison is strictly greater-than; a receipt at the lower boundary is excluded and a receipt at the upper boundary is included
checkpoints.final_checkpoint: the final checkpoint is captured after the last receipt and final batch-boundary checkpoint; its comparison applies through its sequence and is not omitted
checkpoints.consecutive_and_overlapping_intervals: each discontinuity creates its own closed-under-the-upper-bound sequence interval; the union of all such intervals is invalid, so consecutive or overlapping intervals remain invalid without special-case merging
checkpoints.transient_step_rule: a step visible in any checkpoint comparison or a receipt's own wall/monotonic pair invalidates the mechanically specified sample; start/end-only recalibration is never sufficient, and an unobserved sub-cadence step cannot be inferred or promoted to a valid successful latency
checkpoints.implementation_determinism: two faithful implementations supplied the same ordered checkpoint/receipt samples, source event times, tolerance, and UTC-health samples produce exactly the same classifications

finite.ordering: all FINITE values are ordered by seconds and every FINITE value is less than FAILURE_INFINITY

latency_datum_contract.packet_wide_failure: PACKET_CLOCK_PREFLIGHT_INVALID assigns FAILURE_INFINITY to each eligible case for visibility but makes the packet LATENCY_PACKET_VALID=NO and DISCOVERY_LATENCY_GATE=NOT_REPORTABLE_INVALID_CLOCK
latency_datum_contract.p95: N is the count of all eligible universe members, not the count of FINITE datums; for N > 0 use sorted_latency[ceil(0.95*N)-1] over all N tagged datums; N=0 is NOT_REPORTABLE

receipt_clock.latency_population: every eligible universe member receives exactly one latency datum: {kind: FINITE, seconds: non-negative finite} only for a LIVE_FIRST_OBSERVATION with valid absolute UTC preflight, valid local receipt clock, and non-null finite source_event_at; otherwise {kind: FAILURE_INFINITY, reason: frozen failure classification}. Every FINITE value orders below FAILURE_INFINITY. Replay, duplicate, late, timeout, unavailable, malformed, unsupported, invalid-clock, and clock-preflight failures are never omitted

first_buyer_semantics.qualifying_acquisition: successful single-hop Raydium CPMM SwapBaseInput or SwapBaseOutput transferring positive net candidate-mint amount from pool vault to one recipient token-account owner and positive quote amount into the paired pool vault
first_buyer_semantics.success: meta.err == null; missing explicit success is unavailable
first_buyer_semantics.wallet_identity: owner of recipient SPL Token/Token-2022 account, not token-account address, fee payer, pool authority, program, mint authority, or fee account
first_buyer_semantics.duplicates: aggregate same-owner transfer rows within one qualifying swap; later acquisitions do not change first buyer
first_buyer_semantics.ambiguous: multiple positive recipient owners, missing owner, missing required instruction path, or identity collision
first_buyer_semantics.unavailable: provider/chain failure, missing field, failed transaction, unsupported parser, or ambiguity

audit_population.definition: every distinct canonical asset in the closed complete universe snapshot with complete outcome-independent mint, pool, initial signature, slot, and vault identity fields

audit_sampling.note: carried forward byte-identically from the validated V2 High-02 repair; not redesigned by V5
audit_sampling.snapshot: full final eligible universe ledger at census close 2026-09-28T00:30:00Z; include exactly the ordered array of complete outcome-independent asset objects with fields chain_id, mint_address, pool_address, initialization_signature, initialization_slot, block_transaction_index, candidate_vault, quote_vault, and source_event_at; freeze it only after CENSUS_COMPLETE=YES and FINAL_ELIGIBLE_UNIVERSE is sealed; serialize its UTF-8 JSON bytes with RFC8785/JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) and commit SHA-256 before FIRST_BUYER_REQUEST_STARTED or DIRECT_CHAIN_AUDIT_REQUEST_STARTED and before any corresponding result retrieval or inspection

snapshot_field_contract.top_level: bare JSON array; no wrapper object is permitted; N is the exact array length
snapshot_field_contract.member_object: every array member is an object with exactly the nine listed members and no others; no member may be missing or null

field_types.mint_address: JSON string; canonical Solana base58 public-key encoding; decode exactly 32 bytes and canonical re-encoding equals the original string byte-for-byte
field_types.pool_address: JSON string; canonical Solana base58 public-key encoding; decode exactly 32 bytes and canonical re-encoding equals the original string byte-for-byte
field_types.initialization_signature: JSON string; canonical Solana base58 signature encoding; decode exactly 64 bytes and canonical re-encoding equals the original string byte-for-byte
field_types.initialization_slot: non-negative JSON integer; Number.isSafeInteger and RFC8785-compatible; booleans, floats, exponent alternatives, strings, and null forbidden
field_types.block_transaction_index: non-negative JSON integer; Number.isSafeInteger and RFC8785-compatible; booleans, floats, exponent alternatives, strings, and null forbidden
field_types.candidate_vault: JSON string; canonical Solana base58 public-key encoding; decode exactly 32 bytes and canonical re-encoding equals the original string byte-for-byte
field_types.quote_vault: JSON string; canonical Solana base58 public-key encoding; decode exactly 32 bytes and canonical re-encoding equals the original string byte-for-byte
field_types.source_event_at: non-negative JSON integer; Number.isSafeInteger and RFC8785-compatible; booleans, floats, exponent alternatives, strings, and null forbidden; finalized transaction blockTime

snapshot_field_contract.array_order: sort by canonical_asset_identity_bytes in ascending unsigned bytewise lexical order; locale comparison is forbidden
snapshot_field_contract.object_member_order: RFC8785/JCS member ordering; application insertion order is not used
snapshot_field_contract.canonical_asset_identity: exactly the JSON object {"chain_id": <exact chain_id>, "mint_address": <exact mint_address>} with no additional members
snapshot_field_contract.canonical_asset_identity_bytes: UTF-8 bytes of the RFC8785/JCS serialization of that exact canonical_asset_identity object
snapshot_field_contract.digest: SHA-256 of universe_snapshot_bytes, computed before selected-list derivation and before any FIRST_BUYER or DIRECT_CHAIN_AUDIT request starts

audit_sampling.selector: selector_score = SHA256(selector_preimage_bytes); compare raw 32-byte SHA-256 values in ascending unsigned lexicographic byte order; equal scores are ordered by canonical_asset_identity_bytes in ascending unsigned bytewise lexical order; select the first min(200,N) without replacement
audit_sampling.selected_list_commitment: build the selected-list commitment object with the exact frozen schema, RFC8785/JCS-canonicalize its UTF-8 bytes, compute SHA-256 as audit_selected_list_digest, and durably seal the object and digest before any FIRST_BUYER_REQUEST_STARTED or DIRECT_CHAIN_AUDIT_REQUEST_STARTED request or any corresponding result retrieval/inspection
audit_sampling.unavailable_selected_case: retained in the committed sample and denominator; failed selected cases cannot be replaced, redrawn, or shrunk

audit_sample_commit_barrier.note: identical order/schema semantics to AUDIT_SAMPLE_COMMIT_BARRIER_V2, plus binding to WINDOW_CLAIM_KEY and witnessed SAMPLE_COMMITTED lineage event
audit_sample_commit_barrier.purpose: The exact deterministic direct-chain audit selected list is canonicalized, hashed, and durably committed and witnessed before any FIRST_BUYER or DIRECT_CHAIN_AUDIT request can start and before any corresponding result can be retrieved or inspected.
audit_sample_commit_barrier.secrecy_disclaimer: this barrier governs result ordering/control, not census information secrecy; see census_secrecy_disposition
required_state_order: deterministically derive exact ordered selected list
audit_sample_commit_barrier.complete_census_precondition: No snapshot, universe_digest, sample size, selected list, commitment object, or barrier result is valid unless CENSUS_COMPLETE=YES is proven and FINAL_ELIGIBLE_UNIVERSE is frozen from the complete outcome-independent census.
audit_sample_commit_barrier.final_eligible_universe: The frozen complete census membership ledger is the sole source of the audit universe. Later provider success/failure, parse status, first-buyer claims, chain-audit results, agreement, price, volume, survival, attention, or other outcomes cannot add, remove, or alter a member before commitment.

audit_universe_snapshot.top_level: bare JSON array; no wrapper object is permitted; N is the exact array length
audit_universe_snapshot.member_object: every array member is an object with exactly the nine listed members and no others; no member may be missing or null
audit_universe_snapshot.canonical_asset_identity: exactly the JSON object {"chain_id": <exact chain_id>, "mint_address": <exact mint_address>} with no additional members
audit_universe_snapshot.canonical_asset_identity_bytes: UTF-8 bytes of the RFC8785/JCS serialization of that exact canonical_asset_identity object
audit_universe_snapshot.array_order: sort by canonical_asset_identity_bytes in ascending unsigned bytewise lexical order; locale comparison is forbidden

sample_derivation.selector: selector_score = SHA256(selector_preimage_bytes); compare raw 32-byte SHA-256 values in ascending unsigned lexicographic byte order; equal scores are ordered by canonical_asset_identity_bytes in ascending unsigned bytewise lexical order; select the first min(200,N) without replacement
sample_derivation.selected_list: the exact ordered array of selected canonical asset identities, with length sample_size and no duplicate identity

member_contract.window_claim_key: JSON string; exactly the 64 lowercase hexadecimal WINDOW_CLAIM_KEY bound at CLAIM time for this episode's window
member_contract.universe_digest: JSON string; exactly the 64 lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the canonical audit universe snapshot
member_contract.selected_asset_identities: JSON array of exactly sample_size unique canonical identity objects in the frozen selector score order

field_types.sample_size: JSON integer; no quotes, null, boolean, float, or exponent alternative
field_types.selected_asset_identities: JSON array; each member is exactly {chain_id, mint_address} with no extra members, no nulls, and no duplicates

selected_list_canonicalization.input: the complete selected-list commitment object with exactly the required members and no extra members
selected_list_canonicalization.digest: audit_selected_list_digest = lowercase_hex(SHA256(exact RFC8785/JCS UTF-8 commitment-object bytes)); exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters

durable_seal.operation: durably persist the exact canonical commitment-object bytes, audit_selected_list_digest, and seal metadata as one append-only qualification evidence record before emitting barrier PASS
durable_seal.read_back: barrier PASS requires exact durable read-back byte equality and digest equality for the sealed commitment object; a missing, partial, changed, or unreadable seal is FAIL

audit_sample_commit_barrier.barrier_pass_predicate: AUDIT_SAMPLE_COMMIT_BARRIER = PASS if and only if the complete census proof, frozen final universe, canonical universe snapshot, universe_digest, sample_size, ordered selected list, exact-schema commitment object, JCS bytes, audit_selected_list_digest, durable seal, exact read-back, and verified SAMPLE_COMMITTED witness receipt all pass; otherwise PASS is forbidden

post_commit_invalidation.trigger: later evidence invalidates the committed underlying universe or shows the committed snapshot was not the complete eligible universe
post_commit_invalidation.sample_action: do not recompute, replace, redraw, or shrink the audit sample within the same qualification episode
post_commit_invalidation.selected_case_action: retain every committed selected case and its failure/invalidity lineage

denominators.logical_case_rule: one stable scheduled case ID; retries are attempts and duplicates do not add rows

market_state.numerator: count of eligible universe members with status AVAILABLE and every exact market-state field valid from the independent market-state operation
market_state.denominator: all eligible universe members in the closed complete census
market_state.statuses: UNAVAILABLE, MALFORMED, TIMEOUT, UNSUPPORTED, late, invalid, and request failure remain in denominator and are not numerator
market_state.zero: zero denominator is NOT_REPORTABLE and cannot pass

parse.numerator: complete valid expected schema and mandatory fields
parse.denominator: all scheduled logical cases for the role
parse.failure: invalid, malformed, timeout, unavailable, late, and unsupported fail parse; retries do not change denominator

schema.numerator: logical case with a non-duplicate payload violating frozen schema/mandatory fields
schema.denominator: all scheduled logical cases for the role
schema.failure: timeout without payload is parse failure but not schema violation; duplicate conflict is schema evidence

discovery_latency.datum: exactly one tagged datum per eligible universe member: {kind: FINITE, seconds: non-negative finite} or {kind: FAILURE_INFINITY, reason: frozen failure classification}; every FINITE value orders below FAILURE_INFINITY
discovery_latency.numerator: count of FINITE datums, for descriptive reporting only
discovery_latency.denominator: N = count(all eligible universe members in the closed complete census)
discovery_latency.failure: invalid-clock, replay, duplicate, late, missing source_event_at, timeout, unavailable, malformed, unsupported, and clock-preflight failure become FAILURE_INFINITY; packet-wide absolute-clock failure is NOT_REPORTABLE_INVALID_CLOCK, never omission
discovery_latency.p95: if N > 0, sort all N tagged datums by total order and use sorted_latency[ceil(0.95*N)-1]; if N = 0, NOT_REPORTABLE and cannot pass; failures cannot improve the order statistic

first_buyer_availability.numerator: unambiguous first-buyer answer satisfying frozen semantics
first_buyer_availability.failure: all unavailable, malformed, ambiguous, provider-failure, and chain-audit-failure states remain denominator

audit_agreement.numerator: selected Helius identity and order exactly match QuickNode-derived chain truth
audit_agreement.failure: unavailable, malformed, ambiguous, provider-failure, chain-audit-failure, and disagreement are not success; no replacement

denominators.zero_population: all zero denominators are NOT_REPORTABLE and cannot pass

source_role_independence.audit_rule: direct audit uses only separately controlled QuickNode raw chain evidence and pinned Raydium interpretation; never Helius output or a derived/re-exported first-buyer dataset
source_role_independence.shared_backend_rule: census, market-state, and direct audit may share QuickNode infrastructure; this is disclosed and no independence is claimed for market-state

pre_data_gate.deadline_failure: if CLAIM_ANCHORED_AT >= CLAIM_ANCHOR_DEADLINE then V5_LIVE_EPISODE_ELIGIBLE=NO and MEASUREMENT_AUTHORIZED=NO

quicknode_role_budgets.accounting_unit: every QuickNode JSON-RPC request attempt, including retries, consumes one charged raw RPC call; no role may borrow or transfer unused calls

census.order: newest-to-oldest signature-page cursor order, then required block/transaction resolution order
census.retry_charging: initial request and each retry are charged
census.exhaustion: before termination/completeness proof: CENSUS_COMPLETE=NO, PACKET_VALID=NO, SOURCE_STACK_QUALIFIED=NO; never shrink the census

market_state.order: final eligible universe members sorted by canonical_asset_identity_bytes in ascending unsigned bytewise lexical order
market_state.retry_charging: each initial request and up to two retry attempts is charged; the 24-call worst case is reserved before execution
market_state.preflight_fit: after final eligibility closure, require N * 24 <= 40000 before issuing any selective MARKET_STATE request; otherwise PACKET_VALID=NO and SOURCE_STACK_QUALIFIED=NO before execution
market_state.exhaustion: any unexpected exhaustion or incomplete all-member execution yields PACKET_VALID=NO; no sampling, borrowing, or denominator shrinkage

audit.order: the already committed selected-list order, then each case's frozen chain-order request sequence
audit.retry_charging: each initial request and retry attempt is charged
audit.preflight_fit: require sample_size * 50 <= 10000 before executing the committed sample; otherwise PACKET_VALID=NO without changing the sample
audit.exhaustion: any exhaustion before every committed selected case is adjudicated yields PACKET_VALID=NO; no replacement or sample shrinkage

execution_shape.market_state_trigger_ceiling: one independent sequence per final eligible asset, issued only after FINAL_ELIGIBILITY_CONFIRMED_AT in canonical identity order; at most eight request calls and at most 24 charged attempts including two retries per retryable request; no 30-second contemporaneous trigger applies
execution_shape.raw_evidence: retain permitted request/response bytes or immutable reference, SHA-256, source identity, schema/parser identity, timestamps, attempts, result classification, and cost for at least 24 months
execution_shape.parser_identity: later harness commit, Node/npm, contract digest, schema revisions, and parser version bound before first request; post-request change creates a new packet
execution_shape.cost_accounting: record plan, fixed fee, credits, requests, retries, bytes, overages, and invoice/usage evidence per source
execution_shape.failure_preservation: never delete, hide, or denominator-edit failed, late, duplicate, unavailable, invalid, or selected cases

mechanical_falsification_requirements.note: these deterministic artifact assertions are the required bounded repair checks; they are frozen declaratively because no new test file is in the authorized repair scope
mechanical_falsification_requirements.execution: run each assertion against the parsed JSON and Markdown artifacts; every counterexample must be rejected and every expected result must be PASS

required_assertions.counterexample: authoritative execution array contains a dynamic-window resolver
required_assertions.assertion: none of the authoritative execution steps resolves, selects, or recomputes a future window

required_assertions.counterexample: CLAIM_ANCHORED_AT is equal to or later than the deadline but earlier than WINDOW_START
required_assertions.assertion: the only temporal eligibility predicate is CLAIM_ANCHORED_AT < CLAIM_ANCHOR_DEADLINE

required_assertions.counterexample: LIVE_EXECUTION_ELIGIBLE is reached without an explicit deadline verification step
required_assertions.assertion: the authoritative execution array contains VERIFY_CLAIM_ANCHORED_AT_LT_CLAIM_ANCHOR_DEADLINE before LIVE_EXECUTION_ELIGIBLE

required_assertions.counterexample: CLAIM_ONCE receives only a supplied window key
required_assertions.assertion: the claim request requires namespace, window_start, window_end, window_claim_key, episode_id, writer_public_key, initial_claim_digest, and TERMINAL_CONTRACT_BINDING

required_assertions.counterexample: supplied key differs from the witness recomputation
required_assertions.assertion: the witness canonicalizes the exact interval object and requires supplied key equality with its SHA-256 result

required_assertions.counterexample: a shifted interval overlaps a consumed interval and is accepted
required_assertions.assertion: half-open overlap is checked against every previously consumed interval before successful claim consumption

required_assertions.counterexample: the interval registry is consumed without a discoverable CLAIM, or CLAIM is acknowledged without registry consumption
required_assertions.assertion: overlap check, interval consumption, and CLAIM append are one atomic/linearizable witness operation

required_assertions.counterexample: final verification starts from a caller-selected later sequence
required_assertions.assertion: final verification uses LIST_NAMESPACE_FROM_GENESIS with the pinned namespace genesis identity

required_assertions.counterexample: final verification starts after the namespace genesis
required_assertions.assertion: the first returned namespace record is the authenticated genesis/root and current checkpoint extends it

required_assertions.counterexample: witness history contains a sequence or event gap
required_assertions.assertion: all returned witness sequences are contiguous and every event inclusion verifies

required_assertions.counterexample: a successor success is presented without an earlier V5 failure
required_assertions.assertion: complete permanent namespace enumeration rejects success-only selective presentation

required_assertions.counterexample: a later event changes window_claim_key after CLAIM
required_assertions.assertion: every later event equals the immutable EPISODE_BINDING tuple

required_assertions.counterexample: a later event changes episode_id after CLAIM
required_assertions.assertion: every later event equals the immutable EPISODE_BINDING tuple

required_assertions.counterexample: a later event changes initial_claim_digest after CLAIM
required_assertions.assertion: every later event equals the immutable EPISODE_BINDING tuple

required_assertions.counterexample: a later event changes writer_public_key after CLAIM
required_assertions.assertion: every later event equals the immutable EPISODE_BINDING tuple

required_assertions.counterexample: the local authoritative claim is written before external CLAIM_ONCE
required_assertions.assertion: the sole pre-data order places local mirror write after durable inclusion and receipt verification

required_assertions.counterexample: after witness success and a local mirror crash, a fresh machine creates a new claim
required_assertions.assertion: fresh recovery queries the witness and cannot create another claim for the consumed interval

required_assertions.counterexample: DATA_STARTED occurs before witness verification
required_assertions.assertion: APPEND_AND_VERIFY_DATA_STARTED occurs before FIRST_PROVIDER_OR_DATA_OPERATION and after claim receipt verification

required_assertions.counterexample: Markdown and JSON disagree on any R1-R6 semantic
required_assertions.assertion: all closure-relevant R1-R6 objects, constants, order, predicates, bindings, and failure rules compare equal after normalization

required_assertions.counterexample: a historical broad-review attack semantic remains active
required_assertions.assertion: active artifacts contain no dynamic-window, pre-deadline-window-start, pre-witness-local-authority, open-genesis, or caller-selected-history path

required_assertions.counterexample: dynamic-window selection or recomputation is accepted
required_assertions.assertion: the four frozen timestamps are exact literals and no runtime selection is permitted

required_assertions.counterexample: V2 secrecy is resurrected as an execution requirement
required_assertions.assertion: outcome secrecy is not required and no V2 secrecy firewall/allowlist/opaque-store rule is active

required_assertions.counterexample: FIRST_BUYER runs before witnessed SAMPLE_COMMITTED
required_assertions.assertion: the pre-result sample barrier blocks FIRST_BUYER and DIRECT_CHAIN_AUDIT until verified SAMPLE_COMMITTED

required_assertions.counterexample: alternate H-02 sampling bytes or order are used
required_assertions.assertion: the carried-forward V2 byte-exact sampling bytes and order remain authoritative

terminal_contract_binding_attacks.counterexample: claim says the V5 initial broad-review candidate instead of the final V5 terminal commit
terminal_contract_binding_attacks.assertion: TERMINAL_CONTRACT_BINDING requires the later exact prereg_terminal_commit and rejects historical review identity

terminal_contract_binding_attacks.counterexample: claim says the V4 terminal candidate instead of the V5 terminal candidate
terminal_contract_binding_attacks.assertion: V4 identities are provenance only and cannot satisfy TERMINAL_CONTRACT_BINDING

terminal_contract_binding_attacks.counterexample: prereg commit matches but prereg JSON digest does not
terminal_contract_binding_attacks.assertion: the later authorization phase verifies exact Git commit bytes and exact JSON SHA-256

terminal_contract_binding_attacks.counterexample: JSON digest matches another file or version
terminal_contract_binding_attacks.assertion: prereg_json_sha256 must hash the exact V5 JSON path bytes at the exact V5 terminal commit

terminal_contract_binding_attacks.counterexample: execution authorization binds a prerepair authorization candidate
terminal_contract_binding_attacks.assertion: execution_authorization_terminal_commit and execution_authorization_json_sha256 must match the exact terminal authorization candidate

terminal_contract_binding_attacks.counterexample: historical review candidate is accepted because it was reviewed
terminal_contract_binding_attacks.assertion: HISTORICAL_REVIEW_CANDIDATE_IS_EXECUTION_AUTHORITY is false and historical identities are not executable

terminal_contract_binding_attacks.counterexample: the terminal V5 commit field is hard-coded into V5 itself
terminal_contract_binding_attacks.assertion: SELF_REFERENTIAL_COMMIT_LITERAL_FORBIDDEN is true and no active V5 artifact field may contain the eventual V5 Git SHA
initial_claim_digest preimage is the complete seven-member TERMINAL_CONTRACT_BINDING object

terminal_contract_binding_attacks.counterexample: a later witness event detaches from the initial claim binding
terminal_contract_binding_attacks.assertion: the witness preserves initial_claim_digest and immutable EPISODE_BINDING across every later event

authorization.necessary_but_not_sufficient: a successful V5 preregistration closure is necessary but not sufficient for live execution
separate_execution_authorization_must_bi: exact V5 terminal PASS_CLOSED Git commit, bound after V5 closure
exact V5 JSON SHA-256, bound after V5 closure
provider credentials identities without exposing secrets

execution_authorization_attempt.disposition: V4 remains immutable and is not reopened, patched, resumed, or used as an execution-authority binding

historical_review_identity.executable_binding_rule: A historical broad-review candidate, repair base, prerepair candidate, or historical candidate can never satisfy TERMINAL_CONTRACT_BINDING.

TERMINAL_CONTRACT_BINDING.binding_phase: SEPARATE EXECUTION AUTHORIZATION AFTER V5 TERMINAL CLOSURE
TERMINAL_CONTRACT_BINDING.self_referential_commit_rule: V5 must not contain an active executable field attempting to embed the eventual V5 Git commit SHA; that SHA does not exist until commit and embedding it would change the SHA.
TERMINAL_CONTRACT_BINDING.historical_review_identity_rule: Historical review identities are provenance only and can never satisfy this executable binding.
TERMINAL_CONTRACT_BINDING.no_placeholder_submission: Deferred markers are schema documentation only; before CLAIM_ONCE, the later authorization phase must replace every deferred member with the exact verified runtime value.
validation_before_claim_once: prereg_terminal_commit is the exact final PASS_CLOSED V5 Git commit
prereg_json_sha256 is SHA-256 of the exact V5 JSON bytes at that commit
exact-SHA CI belongs to that terminal commit
terminal hostile-review lifecycle closed with 0 Critical / 0 High
execution_authorization_terminal_commit is the exact terminal authorization commit
execution_authorization_json_sha256 matches its exact JSON bytes

initial_claim_digest_contract.binds: all seven required TERMINAL_CONTRACT_BINDING members and their exact values
initial_claim_digest_contract.later_witness_events: Every later witness event remains transitively bound to the same initial_claim_digest through immutable EPISODE_BINDING; it cannot detach from the initial claim.

execution_authorization_validation.phase: SEPARATE EXECUTION AUTHORIZATION AFTER V5 TERMINAL CLOSURE
before_claim_once: prereg_terminal_commit is the exact final PASS_CLOSED V5 Git commit
prereg_json_sha256 matches the exact V5 JSON bytes at that commit
exact-SHA CI belongs to that terminal commit
terminal hostile-review lifecycle is closed with 0 Critical / 0 High
execution_authorization_terminal_commit is the exact terminal authorization commit
execution_authorization_json_sha256 matches the exact authorization JSON bytes
execution_authorization_validation.claim_requirement: CLAIM_ONCE must include the complete TERMINAL_CONTRACT_BINDING, and initial_claim_digest must cryptographically bind it in full.
execution_authorization_validation.later_event_requirement: The witness CLAIM record preserves the binding through initial_claim_digest and every later witness event remains transitively bound by immutable EPISODE_BINDING.
execution_authorization_validation.final_verification_requirement: Compare the witnessed binding against the actual Git artifacts and closure records; any mismatch yields PACKET_VALID=NO / SOURCE_STACK_QUALIFIED=NO.
